title: Things to Do in Genting Highlands from KLIA2
metaDescription: Things to do in Genting Highlands: Awana SkyWay, Chin Swee Temple, SkyWorlds, Skytropolis, the outlets, free things and the bus from KLIA2.

contentBlocks.content: Things to do in Genting Highlands can fill a day or a whole weekend, all on one mountain in Pahang. Ride the Awana SkyWay cable car up from Sky Sentral, stop at Chin Swee Caves Temple on the way, then spend the afternoon at the theme parks or in SkyAvenue at the top (Tourism Malaysia). Pack a jacket, because the air is cool up here. You can go straight from the airport. A direct bus runs from KLIA2 to Awana Genting Highland, and you book it on ttklia.com.
Key Takeaways
How do I get to Genting from KLIA2? Take the direct bus from the KLIA2 Transportation Hub, Level 1, to Awana Genting Highland. Aerobus and Resorts World Tour run it, and you book it on ttklia.com.
How do I get up the mountain? Ride the Awana SkyWay from Sky Sentral to Genting Highlands Station. It takes about 10 minutes and runs 7AM to 11PM.
Is anything free? Yes. The stop at Chin Swee Caves Temple is included in your cable car ticket, children under 90 cm ride the cable car free, and Gohtong Way has free admission.
Is the theme park open every day? No. Genting SkyWorlds closes on Tuesdays, except Malaysian national public holidays and school holidays.
What should I wear? Layers. Expect about 22°C by day and about 12°C at night.
Ride the Awana SkyWay and stop at Chin Swee

The Awana SkyWay carries you from Sky Sentral Station at mid hill to Genting Highlands Station at the peak in about 10 minutes. It runs from 7AM to 11PM (Resorts World Genting). As listed on 5 Nov 2026, a standard gondola costs RM11 one way or RM19 return. The glass floor gondola costs RM32 one way or RM54 return, or RM29 and RM48 when you buy online at least a day ahead. Tickets bought in advance stay valid for 30 days.

content.alt: Awana SkyWay gondolas over the rainforest, with the hilltop resort behind
content.caption: Photo: Jonashtand, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons, resized

contentBlocks.content: Each passenger can take one cabin size bag into the gondola. Coming straight from the airport with a big case? Leave it at the baggage counter on Level 2 of Sky Sentral, open 24 hours, from RM22 for a small bag.

Get off halfway at Chin Swee Station. Chin Swee Caves Temple sits on a rocky slope near the peak. Look for the nine storey lamp lit pagoda, the open air SkyTerrace and the 15 metre statue of Buddha (Resorts World Genting). Tourism Malaysia lists it at 4,600 feet, open 8AM to 7PM daily (Tourism Malaysia). Keep your ticket or QR code, because you need it to carry on to the top. Want the glass floor? Buy it online the day before you go.

content.alt: Carved doors and door guardians at Chin Swee Caves Temple
content.caption: Photo: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons, resized

contentBlocks.content: Spend a day at Genting SkyWorlds

Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park is the outdoor park at the top. It opened in 2022 and is split into nine themed worlds, among them Rio, Ice Age, Epic and Eagle Mountain (Tourism Malaysia). As listed on 5 Nov 2026, it opens daily from 10 AM to 6 PM and closes every Tuesday, except Malaysian national public holidays and school holidays (Genting SkyWorlds).

content.alt: Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park seen from above, with cable cars overhead
content.caption: Photo: Chongkian, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons, resized

contentBlocks.content: Some rides close for planned maintenance, and the park keeps a list on its website. Check that list, then buy your ticket on the SkyWorlds site before you travel.
Skytropolis on a rainy day

Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park is on Level 1 of First World Plaza, beside SkyAvenue, with more than 20 rides under one roof (Resorts World Genting). As listed on 5 Nov 2026, it opens 11AM to 9PM from Sunday to Friday and 11AM to 10PM on Saturday. A 1-Day Unlimited Ride Pass for non-Malaysians is from RM90 online or RM110 at the counter. Single rides cost RM16, or RM22 for the thrill rides. Adults and children pay the same.
Two rides, Super Glider and The Bolt, are listed as temporarily unavailable. Do the sums before you queue: at RM16 a ride, the online pass pays off from about six rides.
SkyAvenue, Snow World and the Ripley's attractions

SkyAvenue is the mall at the top, with more than 100 brands and shops, open daily from 10am (Resorts World Genting). It has lockers on Level 2, a currency exchange on Level 1 and a prayer room on Level G.

content.alt: The lit atrium inside SkyAvenue at the top of Genting Highlands
content.caption: Photo: Chongkian, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons, resized

contentBlocks.content: Under Ripley's Adventureland, Resorts World Genting also lists the Jurassic Research Centre, the 4D Trick Art Museum, the Infinity Room and Snow World (Resorts World Genting). The 4D Trick Art Museum is inside SkyAvenue (Resorts World Genting). Snow World keeps its rooms below zero (Tourism Malaysia). Each one sells its own tickets, so check its site for prices and times on the day you plan to go.
Gardens and rainforest walks

Eufloria Gardens & Sculpture Park is a floral glasshouse and garden in the mid hills, open 10am to 6pm (Resorts World Genting). As listed on 5 Nov 2026, the introductory price for a non-Malaysian adult is RM45, or from RM57 with a return cable car trip, until 31 Dec 2026. Buy your ticket online in advance. The page lists midweek closures, so check its calendar before you pick a day.

For a walk in the rainforest, Genting Nature Adventures runs the Awana Trail. It is 2 km one way, open daily from 8am to 3pm with last entry at 2pm, and takes 45 to 60 minutes (Resorts World Genting). Call the number on that page to book your walk.
Shop at Genting Highlands Premium Outlets

The outlets sit at mid hill next to Sky Sentral, where the Awana SkyWay starts (Resorts World Genting). There are more than 150 designer brands and stores, open daily from 10am to 10pm (Resorts World Genting). Shop on the way down, so you are not carrying bags around the top all day.

content.alt: Entrance of Genting Highlands Premium Outlets at mid hill
content.caption: Photo: Chongkian, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons, resized

contentBlocks.content: Free things to do in Genting

• The Chin Swee stop. It comes with your Awana SkyWay ticket at no extra cost (Resorts World Genting), and Tourism Malaysia notes you can explore the temple for free.
  • Small children ride free. A child under 90 cm tall rides the Awana SkyWay free.
  • Gohtong Way. Free admission, daily from 12 noon to 11pm. Walk in from SkyAvenue Gateway on Level G of SkyAvenue. Resorts World Genting says it is being upgraded, so activities are limited for now (Resorts World Genting).
  • Window shopping. Walking SkyAvenue and the outlets costs nothing.
  • The view. Chin Swee looks out over the mountains from the temple grounds.
Do the free things first in the morning, while the air is clear, then decide which paid attraction is worth the rest of your day.
What to wear in the highlands

Genting SkyWorlds describes a highland climate of about 22°C during the day, dropping to about 12°C at night (Genting SkyWorlds). It suggests a light sweater or jacket, a lightweight rain jacket, long trousers and closed toe shoes. You land in KL heat, so pack these in your day bag and change on the bus.
Getting to Genting from KLIA2 or KL

From KLIA2, take the direct bus from the KLIA2 Transportation Hub, Level 1, to Awana Genting Highland. ttklia.com lists departures by date from Aerobus and Resorts World Tour, and shows the fare on the booking page (ttklia.com). Our KLIA2 bus station guide walks you from arrivals to the bus.

Already in KL? Read KL to Genting Highlands for every way up. For a day out with your own driver, book an 8 or 10 hour car charter on ttklia.com, and use our Genting Highlands day trip guide to plan the stops.

contentBlocks.content: Frequently Asked Questions
What are the things to do in Genting Highlands?

The main things to do in Genting Highlands are the Awana SkyWay cable car, Chin Swee Caves Temple, Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park, SkyAvenue, Eufloria, the Awana Trail and Genting Highlands Premium Outlets.
How do I get to Genting Highlands from KLIA2?
Take the direct bus from the KLIA2 Transportation Hub, Level 1, to Awana Genting Highland. Aerobus and Resorts World Tour run it. Book on ttklia.com, where the fare is shown for your date.
Is Genting SkyWorlds open on Tuesday?
No, Genting SkyWorlds closes every Tuesday, except Malaysian national public holidays and school holidays. On other days it opens 10 AM to 6 PM, as listed on 5 Nov 2026.
What can I do in Genting for free?
You can visit Chin Swee Caves Temple on the free stop that comes with your Awana SkyWay ticket, walk Gohtong Way, which has free admission, and window shop at SkyAvenue and the outlets.
How cold is Genting Highlands?
Genting Highlands is about 22°C during the day and about 12°C at night, according to Genting SkyWorlds. Bring a light jacket and a rain jacket.
How long is the Awana SkyWay ride?
The Awana SkyWay ride takes about 10 minutes from Sky Sentral to Genting Highlands Station, plus any time you spend at the Chin Swee stop.
Conclusion

The things to do in Genting Highlands start at Sky Sentral. Ride the Awana SkyWay, stop at Chin Swee, then choose a theme park, a garden or a walk at the top, and shop at the outlets on the way down. Check the SkyWorlds Tuesday closure before you pick your day. Book your bus from KLIA2 to Genting on ttklia.com.
